description: Provenance-aware question and original angle; reject unrelated or near-duplicate video concept.
Freeze permitted factual claims; missing critical source blocks production.
Load real domain visual/voice rules; no generic theme swap or disabled domain.
Ask/promise, evidence, uncertainty, payoff, and duration ranges; mark claims by ID.
Visual class, permitted source, image/video overlay, speech cue, motion, source & rights dependencies.
Delegate adjudication to existing rights service, unknown legal basis -> HOLD.
Require real new independent critique and source-to-commentary link. No generic green-screen license.
Generate original diagrams or use authorized assets; GPU only if tested/available.
Synth/import voice, measure speech segment duration and align real timing.
Meaning-preserving adaptation, region-safe numbers/names; regenerate text/audio/timing.
Native-script caption and semantic text tracks; collision, safe box and contrast checks.
Track-based mix, speech-first intelligibility, loudness evidence and rights.
Immutable half-open millisecond interval graph, source/rights hashes, scene continuity.
CPU FFmpeg or optional GPU provider, reproducible render manifest and bounded retry.
Manual full watch-through; content-specific acceptance, material edits void approval.
Private export always supported; upload only after correct credentials/policy. Studio dubbing manual handoff.
Use actual owner observations only, compare matched cohorts with uncertainty.
